name: Full-Body Periodized (4/week)
description: A flat, weekly-repeating regiment: an upper day, a lower day, a full-body day, and a weekly stretch reset. Each workout plays the user's one configured playlist. Every week is identical (cycle_weeks = 1); variety comes from the emphasis of each day, and the AI loop (F-04/F-07) later tunes the templates.

cadence.note: 3x HIIT (~30 min: upper, lower, full) + 1x Stretch Reset (~15 min) per week

weeks.description: Upper → Lower → Full, with a stretch reset to finish the week.
